scenes.title: If You Wish for Something, You Have to Make an Effort
scenes.summary: Inspired by Cindy's heartfelt stage song to express his feelings actively, Seung-chan brings Ye-jin a small bouquet right after Joon-mo abruptly tells Ye-jin to lease out her new apartment and stay.
scenes.location: street outside Joon-mo's apartment at night

scenes.title: My Sincerity That Everyone Else Notices
scenes.summary: Coming home worn out while his mother worries his senior is working him to the bone, Seung-chan records a tender confession into his plush bear about wanting to stay beside Ye-jin.
scenes.location: Baek family home and Seung-chan's bedroom

scenes.title: Rent It Out? That Is Not What Matters Right Now!
scenes.summary: Back inside the apartment, Ye-jin presses Joon-mo on why he asked her not to move out, only for both of them to lose their tempers arguing over whether he just likes having housework done.

scenes.title: Ask Him for One Thing and He Writes a Thesis
scenes.summary: After Joon-mo marvels at Seung-chan's thesis-level scouting binder, Ye-jin vents over fiery stew about her fight with Joon-mo—and catches Seung-chan smiling with relief that she is still moving out.
scenes.location: KBS office and spicy stew restaurant

scenes.title: This Package-Deal Tactic Is Just the Agency Head's Preview
scenes.summary: Waiting in the van, Cindy's manager urges her to apologize to CEO Byun before her rookie package-deal tactics escalate into full-scale ruin like a former agency star's downfall.

scenes.title: Do Not Underestimate It Just Because It Is Thirty Seconds
scenes.summary: With cancellation rumors swirling after a rival pilot's success, Seung-chan volunteers to edit his first thirty-second episode preview and vows to prove a rookie is more than a food-delivery app.

scenes.title: A Producer Must Unconditionally Love His Cast
scenes.summary: While Tae-ho frets over keeping an awkward night quiet, Joon-mo reviews Seung-chan's all-night preview cut, points out that Cindy fails to shine, and tells him a producer must love his cast.

scenes.title: Even Love Needs a Preview
scenes.summary: Boasting of her uncanny romantic intuition, Ye-jin mistakenly assumes Seung-chan is pining after Cindy and advises him that real-life confessions need a preview first—prompting him to ask what preview she likes.

scenes.title: I Actually Prefer a Preview Filled with Sincerity
scenes.summary: After Tae-ho confesses how noticing someone's absence confused him, Ye-jin calmly tells Joon-mo she must move out so both of them can tell lifelong familiarity apart from real love.
scenes.location: bar and Joon-mo's apartment at night

scenes.title: Who Wrote Something Like This? Umbrella PD?
scenes.summary: After pulling another all-nighter, Seung-chan hallucinates variety-show captions over lunch choices, while Cindy reads his bizarrely pitiful preview script in her van and decides to record it anyway.
scenes.location: KBS editing room and Cindy's van

scenes.title: You Look Much Prettier When the Main Camera Is Not Rolling
scenes.summary: Sending her manager out for herbal tea, Cindy records Seung-chan's brutally honest preview voiceover and blushes when he tells her she looks prettiest when no camera or mirror is in front of her—like right now.

scenes.title: The Woman I Like Is Not Cindy
scenes.summary: Outside the booth, Seung-chan sincerely apologizes to Cindy for misjudging her at her home; when Ye-jin spots them and teases him, Seung-chan firmly tells her the woman he likes is not Cindy—and he has not given his preview yet.

scenes.title: Frankly, I Held an Umbrella Over You a Hundred Times More
scenes.summary: In the van, Cindy's manager sulks hilariously upon realizing he was NOT the 'umbrella in the rain' from her Music Bank acceptance speech, while Tae-ho sheepishly apologizes at the office.

scenes.title: Cannot We Just Lease That Place Out and Keep Living Like This?
scenes.summary: Over their last morning meal before moving day, Ye-jin's younger brother Ye-joon complains about getting carsick on long commutes and begs Joon-mo to lease out Ye-jin's apartment—echoing Joon-mo's exact words.

scenes.title: Since When Does an Add-On Go Ahead of the Main Star?
scenes.summary: Ambushing Cindy's solo fan event by seating a rookie trainee in Cindy's chair, CEO Byun backs down only when Cindy coolly threatens to ruin the rookie's makeup—before a lawyer uncle-fan offers free legal help.

scenes.title: That Is Producer Baek Seung-chan's Debut Work
scenes.summary: Invited to dinner at Seung-chan's parents' home, Joon-mo politely endures Bo-sun and Jum-soon bragging wildly about Seung-chan—and reassures them his eccentric debut preview worked because everyone is talking about it.

scenes.title: Stop Threatening Me, and Do Not Ruin Cindy
scenes.summary: Confronting CEO Byun over a bogus breach-of-contract warning letter, Cindy reveals she checked the facts through a legal-trainee fan and warns Byun not to destroy Cindy during the ten months left on her contract.

scenes.title: I Did Not Plan It, Yet That Became My Preview
scenes.summary: After accidentally playing the plush bear's recorded confession in Seung-chan's bedroom, stunned Ye-jin meets Seung-chan at the playground—where he pulls her swing close and kisses her as his real-life preview.
scenes.location: Seung-chan's room and apartment playground at night
